reason: Adds a DeepSeek Harness sidebar usage panel that visualizes local token usage, per-model cost estimates, pricing periods, and optionally the account balance from DeepSeek's balance endpoint.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中添加用量面板，展示本地会话统计、按模型的成本估算、定价时段和可选的账户余额。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness usage panel showing local session statistics, per-model cost estimates, pricing periods, and an optional account balance.

capabilities: Reads local session logs to calculate usage statistics
Calls the DeepSeek balance endpoint when an API key is configured
Serves balance, local usage, and pricing-period data through local HTTP routes
Displays usage summaries, charts, session breakdowns, and model statistics in a sidebar panel
